description: Report an AI design anti-pattern that is NOT yet in the library, for a design failure seen repeatedly that a search of the library does not find. Reports are reviewed by a human before anything is published, and published entries credit the reporter.

credit.description: Name or handle to credit if this is published. Optional.

description.description: What it looks like and why it is a failure. Two or three sentences.

example.description: A short code or copy snippet showing it. Optional. Do not include anything proprietary.

name.description: A short memorable name for the pattern, e.g. "Skeleton That Never Resolves".

whereSeen.description: Product name or URL where you saw it. Optional but makes the report far more useful.

name: report_pattern
title: Report a new pattern
